limits.deadline_semantics: Absolute stable-input deadline passed into request execution; guard and polling clamped to deadline. Request window bounds completion, guard included when time remains.

limitations: Finite digital mailbox model, no chemical accuracy or physical conditioning validation.
Firmware application 2.0.0 and always-awake pins are the inherited software fixture choice, not hardware measurements.
Figure7 reset/application timing uses typical model delays; premature commands return modeled NACK, not mandatory min-delay assertion.
DATA_READY clearance does not erase retained gas output; caches and repeated reads allowed.
Environment/baseline/download operations outside this bounded model are model_unsupported.
ERROR_ID latch behavior is modeled; no forced acknowledgment or invalid-range rejection policy is imposed on the healthy-function score.
Transport/device-fault diagnostics are reported separately; core pass is not complete fault-recovery proof.
Not an OS sandbox for hostile candidate code.
